newsitem.title: UK: Usborne sells grain unit to Sidney C Banks.
newsitem.headline: Usborne sells grain unit to Sidney C Banks.

text.p: Usborne plc sold its UK grain merchanting subsidiary Usborne Grain Ltd to grain traders Sidney C Banks plc for around 4.1 million stg, Usborne said in a statement on Friday.
Usborne Grain's customers include brewers, maltsters and animal feed compounders, Usborne plc said.

"The board is pleased to have concluded a sale to a purchaser which has a similar trading philosophy to that of Usborne Grain and that the combined business will enable farmer customers to continue to enjoy access to markets in the United Kingdom and continental Europe with a strong independent trading company," it said.
